pretreatments.description: Size reduction via hammer mill grinding to particle size < 1 mm, followed by sieving to 32–42 mesh (Tyler Standard Screen Scale) to select particles of 0.354–0.5 mm.
Ozone pretreatment: Ozone produced by a L11–L24 Ozone Generator at 5.3% ozone concentration and 2000 ml/min flow rate for 10 min, with a dose of 0.79 g O3/g TS.

Soaking aqueous ammonia (SAA) pretreatment: Soaking grass waste particles in 28–30% (w/w) ammonium hydroxide solution at 50 °C for 24 h without agitation, followed by washing twice with distilled water.
Ozone combined with SAA (OSAA) pretreatment: Ozone pretreatment followed by SAA pretreatment for 6 h at 50 °C without agitation.
Enzymatic hydrolysis: Using cellulase (30 FPU/g) and β-glycosidase (30 CBU/g) in 0.05 M sodium citrate buffer (pH 4.8) at 50 °C for 72 h.
